Leverage Mockito and embedded servers (e.g., GreenMail for mail sink) for mocking external dependencies.
Structure tests using JUnit 5 with parameterized tests for data-driven scenarios.
Implement shared test utilities for common setup (e.g., JSON parsing, message routing).
Use Docker-based test containers for hdfs-dataset sink to simulate HDFS in CI.
assumptions: All modules (json-tuple, script, scripts, splitter, gauge, aggregate-counter, field-value-counter, hdfs-dataset, mail) are already implemented and functional.
CI pipeline (e.g., Jenkins/GitHub Actions) is pre-configured to execute tests.
Dependencies for testing (e.g., Spring Test, Mockito, TestContainers) are already available in the project.
No additional documentation or code changes are required beyond writing tests.
Each module's acceptance test requires independent setup and execution.

activities.activity_description: Configure test dependencies, shared utilities, and CI integration for acceptance tests.
Write and validate tests for JSON tuple processing logic.
Write and validate tests for single script execution scenarios.
Write and validate tests for multi-script execution scenarios.
Write and validate tests for message splitting logic.
Write and validate tests for gauge metric collection.
Write and validate tests for time-based aggregation logic.
Write and validate tests for field value counting logic.
Write and validate tests for HDFS dataset output using TestContainers.
Write and validate tests for email sending using embedded mail server.
